glossary.definition: One of four levels of trust a personal agent holds: public, signed in, step-up satisfied, CIBA approved. Each rung needs its own proof.
A fresh, stronger authentication required before a sensitive action. In this demo it is a MOCK check, not a real tenant policy.
Client-Initiated Backchannel Authentication: the requester asks for an approval and a separate device (here, a mock phone) decides.
The authentication context class in a proof. This demo uses two MOCK values; the values a real PingOne issues are UNVERIFIED.
A proof's unique id. A proof is single use: presenting it again is refused as a replay.
A fall to a lower rung. It happens by an explicit step-down with a reason, by a proof window ending, or by a single-use approval being spent. Risk alone never lowers a rung.
